rules.statement: The sale was set aside due to the illegality of the writ, rendering the sale void.
rules.supporting_quote: and his finding is not disputed on this point-that there was no material irregularity under section 282, but set aside the sale on the ground that, the writ being illegally issued, the sale was void, basing his judgment on Palaniappa Chetty v.
